topics.label: Lecture Introduction and Learning Objectives
topics.groupedBecause: This topic introduces the lecture and outlines its core learning objectives regarding cancer evolution.

topics.label: Clonal Selection and Intrinsic Drivers of Early Transformation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics demonstrate how cell-intrinsic alterations drive clonal expansion and early cancer evolution.

topics.label: Influence of Cell of Origin and Tissue Hierarchy on Malignancy
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how the differentiation state and hierarchical position of the cell of origin determine susceptibility to oncogenic transformation.

topics.label: Role of the Microenvironment in Tumor Promotion and Growth
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how external microenvironmental cues and supportive stroma enable tumor growth and progression.

topics.label: Technologies for Studying Tumor Evolution and Microenvironments
topics.groupedBecause: This topic explains the modern experimental and computational technologies used to study tumor evolution and cellular interactions.

topics.label: Integrated Evolutionary Model of Cancer Development
topics.groupedBecause: This topic synthesizes the diverse intrinsic and extrinsic factors that converge to drive cancer evolution.

topics.label: Closing Remarks
topics.groupedBecause: This topic concludes the lecture and previews the upcoming session on cancer therapy.
